hooks.name: Regenerate report Word doc
hooks.description: When docs/PROJECT-REPORT.md is saved, regenerate docs/PROJECT-REPORT.docx so the Word copy stays in sync with the markdown source of truth.

action.command: if [ -d docs/report-gen/node_modules ]; then cd docs/report-gen && npm run build; else echo "report-gen deps not installed - run: cd docs/report-gen && npm install"; fi
